faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Bhagalpur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Bhagalpur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bhagalpur, by personally or through registered post, to reach by 7 December 2026.
